question: As a tribute to the 1857 hero Babu Kunwar Singh, the IAF Surya Kiran Air Show dazzled the skies of ________ in April 2025.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Patna**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Surya Kiran Aerobatic Team (SKAT)** of the Indian Air Force (IAF) performed an air show in **Patna** in April 2025. This event was organized as a tribute to the 1857 hero **Babu Kunwar Singh**.
 
• **Babu Kunwar Singh** was a prominent leader during the **Indian Rebellion of 1857**. He is celebrated for his courageous leadership in the fight against British colonial rule.
